content.short: Humanbound is an on-chain verification and management protocol.
content.description: Humanbound, created by the Berlin-based DeFi Labs team, provides infrastructure for on-chain identity. It runs on the Violet protocol, a composable identity management protocol. Acting as a bridge between DApps and users, it enables secure, seamless interactions. The Humanbound token is a soul-bound, non-transferable credential used for on-chain identity and as a symbolic record of achievements. This setup centers identity management around a soul-bound credential.
